subject.title: [Feature]: google-meet: retain the full caption transcript per session (recentTranscript is a 5-line window over a 50-line buffer)

question: Should the Google Meet plugin retain complete live captions only for the active in-memory session, or persist them across gateway restarts?
rationale: This choice determines privacy, lifecycle, storage schema, deletion behavior, and the permanent CLI/API contract for sensitive meeting content.

options.title: Ephemeral Session Stream
options.body: Keep complete bounded captions and cursor state in memory until the session or gateway ends.

options.title: Persistent SQLite Transcript
options.body: Store captions across restarts with explicit retention, deletion, access, and migration behavior.

options.title: Keep Diagnostic Window
options.body: Leave live caption status bounded and rely on existing post-meeting Google Meet transcript artifacts for durable records.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Session Stream
recommendation.body: Keep complete bounded captions and cursor state in memory until the session or gateway ends.

likelyOwner.reason: The original plugin and caption-health implementation history most strongly routes this product decision to @steipete.
